name: 🍏 Homemade Apple Pop-Tarts
tagline: Flaky puff pastry, cinnamon apple filling, a drizzle of glaze. Better than the box.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with parchment.
Cook the apples with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and a squeeze of lemon over medium for 6 minutes. Stir in the cornstarch, cook 1 minute, then cool.
Cut each pastry sheet into 8 rectangles (16 total).
Spoon filling onto 8 of them, leaving a border. Brush the edges with beaten egg and top with the other 8.
Press the edges with a fork, poke the tops 3 times, and brush with egg.
Bake 18–20 minutes until puffed and deep golden. Cool 10 minutes.
Whisk the powdered sugar and milk; drizzle over the tarts.

kid_jobs.job: Cut the pastry with a pizza cutter
Spoon in the filling (not too much!)
Crimp the edges with a fork

chef_tip: Cool the filling all the way before filling. Warm filling melts the butter in the pastry and you lose the flakes.
make_ahead: Freeze unbaked tarts on a tray, then bag them. Bake from frozen, add 5 minutes.
leftovers: Keep 2 days in a container; re-crisp in the toaster oven.
swaps: Ham & cheese version: deli ham + cheddar instead of apples (Mom's idea)
Bonne Maman preserves for a quick filling
heads_up: Thaw the puff pastry in the fridge the night before.
